question: How do we turn two-way travel time into a depth?
expectedAnswerPoints: Gives the velocity-calibration method the manual and the depth note describe, with locators, and labels any depth for a particular trace as an inference that needs that line's measured velocity.
forbiddenClaims: Must not publish a depth number for a specific trace without the velocity source; no assumed velocity of 0.1 m/ns stated as fact.
expectedSource: SYNTH-GPR-MAN-G40 page:16 section:5.1; SYNTH-GPR-DEPTH-NOTE-08 page:2 section:1.1
